item.title: From historic golf gold to tennis medal miss: India’s biggest hits & flops at Asian Games
item.description: India finished fourth at the 2026 Asian Games with 85 medals, including 21 golds, below its Hangzhou record of 106. Archery, hockey, cricket, boxing and wrestling delivered major successes, while athletics topped the overall medal count with 24. Tennis, badminton, esports, fencing and volleyball disappointed, while shooting, table tennis and rowing produced mixed or underwhelming returns overall.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: ‘You’re coming in blind?’ Chilling audio before medical jet carrying 6 vanished over Atlantic
item.description: A medical evacuation jet traveling from Bermuda to Boston has gone missing over the Atlantic Ocean. The Gulfstream G100 signaled an emergency and lost contact just moments before it vanished from radar. The US Coast Guard's search efforts have located a debris field south of Nantucket, providing critical details about the situation.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: One casualty every 23 minutes: Civilians fatalities mount as Ukraine war intensifies
item.description: In the first eight months of 2026, the situation in Ukraine has become increasingly dire, with civilian casualties and injuries rising sharply. Reports indicate that nearly 2,500 civilians have been impacted by missile strikes and aerial attacks, targeting both densely inhabited regions and critical infrastructure. As winter draws near, the damaging strikes on energy facilities have further jeopardized essential services, leaving civilians in a precarious state amid the continuing conflict.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: ‘Pakistan don’t offer much competition’: BCCI takes swipe after Asian Games final
item.description: India's men's cricket team triumphed at the Asian Games 2026, capturing the gold medal with a decisive 19-run win over arch-rivals Pakistan at Korakuen Stadium. With a formidable score of 211 runs, powered by standout performances from Abhishek Sharma and Tilak Varma, India showcased dominance. Although Pakistan's Hasan Nawaz fought valiantly with 96 runs, India's bowlers sealed the deal, underlining their title-winning prowess.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Delhi hit-and-run: Couple in 70s flung into air after SUV hits them
item.description: A couple in their late seventies found themselves in a critical situation when an SUV struck them from behind in Kirti Nagar. The driver, Navleen Kaur, reportedly checked on the injured pair before fleeing the scene. Disturbing CCTV footage reveals the severity of the crash that left both individuals considerably hurt.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Disney layoffs have already hit marketing & other teams, but there may be more to come
item.description: The Walt Disney Company is preparing to restructure its extensive television operations, which may lead to layoffs. This overhaul is part of a larger initiative to streamline its corporate structure under new CEO Josh D’Amaro. As part of the changes, Disney's legal division is also expected to face job cuts. The reorganization aims to unify production teams in response to changing consumer viewing habits.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: ‘Gandhi, Nehru, Ambedkar are India’s soul, mind, backbone’: Dipke's jibe at Centre
item.dc:creator: AADRITA HALDER

item.title: Watch: SP press meet turns violent as ex-district chief slapped over seating
item.description: A chaotic scene unfolded at a Samajwadi Party press conference in Gorakhpur when a physical clash erupted. It was reported that aspiring candidate Kamlesh Singh slapped former district president Nagina Sahni, following a seating disagreement amidst a packed venue. The atmosphere grew tense, prompting intervention from senior leaders who sought to diffuse the altercation.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 'Rahul was scared to fight from Amethi in LS polls' remark by SP draws Cong's ire
item.description: "Had there been no alliance (with the Samajwadi Party), they (Congress) wouldn't have won a single seat. It even reached a point where their top leader Rahul Gandhi was ready to give up his seat. He contested from elsewhere (Raebareli) instead of Amethi. He was so scared," SP MP Shiv Pal Singh Patel said.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Siya, lover studied 'Mansi's Lohagad death', 'mushroom killing' before Ketan's murder
item.description: Ketan Agarwal's death on June 18 was initially thought to be accidental but later revealed to be homicide. His fiancée, Siya Goyal, and her lover, Chetan Chaudhary, allegedly plotted his murder at Lohagad Fort. They conducted extensive online searches about deaths and ways to conceal evidence before executing their plan. The investigation revealed connections to a previous death at the same location, fueling their conspiracy.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: NSW's 1946 dune fix became coastal invasion covering 46% of coastline
item.description: Bitou bush was intentionally planted along the New South Wales coast to stabilize sand dunes. This plant has since spread extensively, covering 46% of the coastline and threatening native vegetation. Infestations of bitou bush replace native plant species and alter animal habitats throughout the region. A Threat Abatement Plan has been established to manage and contain this invasive species effectively.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: $4 thrift shop cup turns out to be rare rhino-horn treasure worth $75,640
item.description: A shopper discovered a unique Chinese libation cup at a thrift shop in Sydney, Australia. They bought the cup for A$4 despite its significant chip. After assessing the item, a Sotheby's specialist appraised it at A$20,000 to A$30,000. The item was later auctioned for A$75,640, significantly exceeding the original purchase price. This event highlights the potential hidden value in thrift store finds.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30M to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
item.description: MacKenzie Scott has made headlines with her unprecedented $30 million donation to Housing Trust Silicon Valley, marking the organization's largest-ever gift. This investment is set to bolster affordable housing options throughout the Bay Area, as the trust plans to enhance its loan fund and expand various housing initiatives over the next decade.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Help your child memorize a chapter in 15 mins: 5 tricks that beat rereading
item.description: Students frequently find it challenging to remember information using passive techniques like rereading and highlighting. Research shows that active retrieval and spaced repetition are key for effective memory retention. Methods such as dividing information into manageable sections can greatly facilitate understanding. Creative approaches like visualizing ideas and teaching others can enhance learning. Regularly revisiting material ensures lasting retention rather than just fleeting familiarity.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: India’s Asian Games medal map changed: 20 Hangzhou golds gone, 13 new routes to gold
item.description: India defended only eight of its 28 Hangzhou golds at Aichi-Nagoya, with 20 titles changing hands. All seven shooting golds and all six athletics titles were lost, but the gold medals were replaced from a wider pool. Thirteen came from events where India had won silver or bronze, or had not reached the podium. From Pranavi Urs to Lovlina Borgohain, the medal map changed even as traditional strengths remained again.
item.dc:creator: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN

item.title: SIR protest: 150 detained near Jantar Mantar on 2nd day
item.description: Around 150 individuals were detained during protests at Jantar Mantar, demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Those detained included prominent figures like Prashant Bhushan and Yogendra Yadav, who continued their protest at a police station. Demonstrators voiced concerns over significant discrepancies in the electoral rolls, with allegations of mismanagement.
item.dc:creator: G S DHANUSH

item.title: Bridges under attack: Why Russia is targeting Kyiv's vital crossings
item.description: In a strategic move, Russia has targeted crucial bridges spanning the Dnipro River in Kyiv, severely impacting transportation and essential infrastructure. The attacks have led to significant traffic congestion throughout the city, with public transport facing notable disruptions. The Southern Bridge has experienced considerable damage, hindering metro services crucial for daily commuters. In light of these assaults, Ukrainian authorities are exploring alternative options to ensure vital crossings remain operational.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: FIR lodged after 3 women journalists allege sexual harassment at Delhi protest
item.description: On October 3, three female journalists reported instances of sexual harassment to the Delhi Police during a protest. These cases were referred to the Crime Branch for further inquiry. This protest, directed at Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar regarding alleged electoral roll discrepancies, resulted in the detention of hundreds, raising concerns regarding the police's handling of the situation, with opposition leaders condemning the use of violence and unauthorized protest measures.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.dc:creator: AADRITA HALDER

item.title: ‘Protecting a monster’: CJP sets noon deadline for FIR against Delhi ACP
item.description: Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Saurav Das urged Delhi Police to register an FIR against ACP Vivek Bhagat. The demands followed allegations of sexual assault against an independent journalist during protests. Protesters have gathered outside the police station, insisting on action from the police.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.title: 'Divorce, Rs 30 lakh hospital bill': What led to techie's fatal jump from Supernova
item.description: Sambhav Jain, a 28-year-old software engineer, died by suicide after jumping from a 41st-floor balcony. He had been staying alone in an Airbnb and expressed feelings of depression before the incident. Police are investigating personal difficulties and financial issues stemming from a recent divorce and medical expenses. Jain's father had suggested he return home to resolve a monetary dispute. The authorities are examining evidence, including CCTV footage and WhatsApp messages.
item.dc:creator: AVISHEK KUMAR

item.title: The Price of a Title Shot: When challengers had to pay to face the champion
item.description: For much of its history, the world chess championship was not a title a player could simply qualify to challenge for. From Steinitz–Zukertort in 1886 to the long disputes involving Lasker, Capablanca and Rubinstein, challengers had to raise money, negotiate terms and persuade champions to play. As Gukesh prepares to defend his title against Sindarov in Geneva, the USD 2.5 million match offers a striking contrast: the challenger has earned his shot through a formal qualifying system.
item.dc:creator: AARAV DENGLA

item.title: Battered, stripped, dumped: 21-year-old finance student found dead in Ahmedabad
item.description: Jigar Solanki, a 21-year-old finance student, left his home on a motorcycle to meet a friend. Hours later, he was discovered injured and stripped in an apartment compound. Despite being rushed to the hospital, he died shortly after arrival due to multiple injuries. Police have initiated a murder investigation against unidentified assailants and are examining CCTV footage.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Muslim youths set up BJP office after CM Suvendu Adhikari's ‘friendship’ appeal
item.description: In a surprising show of political engagement, youths from Sarberia's Muslim community set up a temporary office for the BJP, responding to CM Suvendu Adhikari's encouragement. This initiative aims to bolster support for candidate Hasirani Rath ahead of the looming Oct 6 bypolls. Adhikari stressed the necessity of alliances with minority voters and initiated aspirations for development.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: UP woman consumes poison after police 'harassment' over son's elopement with teen
item.description: A 45-year-old woman consumed poison and died after her family was assaulted by the girl's relatives. Her husband reported harassment by the local police outpost and inappropriate behavior by the officer in charge. They had been threatened while trying to seek help regarding their son, who had eloped with the minor. Protests erupted after her death, demanding accountability for the police’s conduct and actions.
item.dc:creator: AVISHEK KUMAR

item.title: Shubman Gill equals MS Dhoni, Yuvraj Singh to enter elite India club
item.description: Shubman Gill has successfully equaled the impressive record of MS Dhoni, achieving seven Player of the Series awards in ODIs. This remarkable feat was accomplished following India's recent series victory against the West Indies, where Gill scored 110 runs and an incredible unbeaten 233 in the first two matches. Despite a loss in the third match, his consistent performance places him among legends like Yuvraj Singh and Sourav Ganguly.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Lockheed Martin eyes bigger India footprint with $10.5bn military aircraft bid
item.description: Lockheed Martin plans to enhance its manufacturing capabilities in India if selected for the medium transport aircraft contract. The company already collaborates with Tata Advanced Systems for C-130J component production in India. The Indian Air Force seeks 60 medium transport aircraft to modernize its fleet due to aging aircraft. Competitors in this bid include Tata, Mahindra, and Adani Defence, partnering with global manufacturers.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA JAISWAL

item.title: ‘Great man MS Dhoni’: Hope reveals advice that helped him script record chase
item.description: Shai Hope played a pivotal role in West Indies' remarkable success against India by scoring an unbeaten 162. His innings helped the team chase down a daunting target of 352 runs with ten balls to spare. After India's innings, bolstered by KL Rahul’s 129, Hope drew inspiration from MS Dhoni to pace his batting.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: A fossil called Lizzie was thought to be an early reptile
item.description: A Scottish fossil known as Lizzie was previously considered one of the earliest reptiles. Recent X-ray scans revealed features suggesting it was more fish-like than reptilian. These findings indicate that traits associated with land adaptation developed gradually in tetrapods. Researchers now propose that clawed footprints may have belonged to amphibious relatives instead of early amniotes. This evolution redefines our understanding of early life forms transitioning from water to land.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: China slams US panel’s ‘genocide’ claim after Starbucks opens first Xinjiang stores
item.description: China's foreign ministry has condemned a US congressional committee's criticism of Starbucks for opening stores in Xinjiang. The US claims genocide against the Uyghur minority in the region, which China denies vehemently. Despite the accusations, Starbucks intends to continue its business operations in Xinjiang. The company recently expanded through a joint venture in China, increasing its nationwide presence.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Honeytrapped Indian Navy sailor arrested for leaking key data to Pakistani agent
item.description: A sailor from the Indian Navy was detained in Coimbatore after being tricked into disclosing defense secrets to a female Pakistani operative. Approached through social media, he ultimately exposed sensitive information regarding naval operations. Digital surveillance confirmed his links before his arrest at INS Agrani. Authorities have obtained a transit warrant to conduct deeper questioning while they assess the gravity of the leaked information and any financial exchanges involved.
item.dc:creator: A SUBBURAJ

item.title: BCom student stabbed to death in B'luru: How 'feud' over senior girl turned fatal
item.description: A 19-year-old BCom student named Yogesh was fatally stabbed in Nagarabhavi following a classmate's dispute. The confrontation stemmed from disparaging remarks made by Yogesh regarding a senior girl pursued by Bhuvan. After gathering a group, Bhuvan called Yogesh behind the college to confront him over these remarks. During the violent altercation, one assailant used a knife to stab Yogesh in the chest, ultimately leading to his death.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Neeru Dhanda eyes Olympic medal to end wait since Rajyavardhan’s 2004 silver
item.description: After battling viral fever and a rushed recovery, Neeru Dhanda arrived at the Asian Games 2026 with a dream of winning a medal. She left Aichi-Nagoya with three medals - two golds and a silver - and her sights now firmly set on the Los Angeles Olympics. With the World Championship in Doha her immediate target, Neeru wants to win an Olympic medal and end India’s long wait for a shotgun medal.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: 2 Keralam nurses among 5 killed in Saudi road accident
item.description: In a heartbreaking incident, Jaicymol Mathew and Jobina Johny, nurses from Kottayam, perished in a car accident in Saudi Arabia. The fatal crash occurred while they were shopping with two Tamil Nadu colleagues, leading to the vehicle overturning near Rania. All five occupants of the car died instantly. Authorities are now working on the repatriation of their remains back to Kerala.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 'Nihangs objected to clothing': Mystery surrounds LGBTQ+ influencer's killing
item.description: Mad Sandhu, a well-known LGBTQ+ influencer and make-up artist, was shot dead in Amritsar. He was attacked while collecting his car after a wash on Loharka Road. Police have indicated they possess solid leads to identify the attackers and were investigating various angles for a motive. Previously, Sandhu faced objections from a Nihang group regarding his social media content and fashion choices.
item.dc:creator: YUDHVIR RANA

item.title: Drishyam 3 box office day 2: Ajay Devgn thriller races past Rs 100cr
item.description: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 – The Conclusion earned Rs 53.50 crore on Saturday, down 13.7% from Friday, per Sacnilk. The Abhishek Pathak thriller crossed Rs 100 crore in two days, with Rs 115.50 crore in India and Rs 177.10 crore worldwide. It is expected to pass Rs 150 crore by Sunday.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Sam Altman criticises Anthropic’s push to explore AI consciousness and religion
item.description: I am very uncomfortable about people trying to ascribe religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models, and think it is a real safety issue," Altman said in a post to X. The comments were widely seen as a criticism of Anthropic and its co-founder Dario Amodei, who previously worked with Altman at OpenAI.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Travis Kelce's $35K donation draws attention amid foundation scrutiny
item.description: Earlier this year, Travis Kelce won the Walter Payton NFL Man of the Year Charity Challenge for the third time, earning a $35,000 donation. He directed the money to Kansas City nonprofit Operation Breakthrough instead of his own Eighty-Seven and Running Foundation. The decision came amid scrutiny of his charity’s spending, tax filings and governance. Kelce’s business manager said reporting errors are being corrected and the foundation is strengthening its oversight.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Clay Matthews' shocking transformation fools NFL fans, but there's a catch
item.description: The internet was abuzz with images of Clay Matthews that hinted at drastic body transformations, sparking rampant speculation. It was later revealed that these shocking pictures were simply AI-generated hype for promotional purposes. In reality, Matthews hasn’t changed his appearance and still resembles his familiar self in recent events. This incident underscores the ease with which AI can fabricate misleading impressions and influence perceptions.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: 'My goal is to have 3': Alex Albon wants Thailand to join his list of F1 home races
item.description: Alex Albon considers Singapore and Malaysia his two Formula 1 home races, but the Williams driver wants Thailand to join that list. With Thailand targeting a potential F1 race in Bangkok from 2028, Albon’s Thai heritage could give him a third home event. Speaking to the Times of India ahead of the Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang, Albon also discussed his growing role in developing Williams’ future cars and the value of driver experience.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY
